title: Switch museum tour meeting point
goal: When the drop-down box option changes, the meeting point for the new session is displayed.
summary: After the selection item is changed, the drop-down box will trigger change. select.value is the value of the selected option, which can be used to retrieve prompts from the existing rendezvous point table.
tasks: listens for changes on #tour. Read the current value each time it is triggered and find the corresponding prompt from the existing meetingPoints.
Write found tips to #meeting-point. Displays "Please select the tour session first." when switching back to empty options.

example.note: The drop-down box of the recipe uses the number of people as the option value. After each switch, the prompt will display a new number of people.

hint: When the initial prompt is still displayed after changing the session, check whether selectedIndex is used when fetching the prompt. The key to the existing rendezvous table is the value of the option.
